tools.name: read_denial_letter
tools.description: Use when someone pastes or uploads a health insurance denial, EOB or adverse benefit determination. Pass the letter text verbatim. Returns what was denied, the reason category, the plan type (employer/ERISA, Marketplace, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid), the appeal deadline computed from the regulation

tools.name: appeal_deadlines
tools.description: Compute health insurance appeal deadlines when there is no letter text, only facts: plan type and the date on the denial. Returns each deadline with the regulation it comes from, computed in code. The tool does not assess medical necessity.

tools.name: how_long_to_appeal_insurance_denial
tools.description: How long a person has to appeal a health insurance denial, for each plan type or one: employer (ERISA), government employer, Marketplace, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Original Medicare, FEHB. With a plan type and the letter date it returns the exact date; without them it returns the window for ever

tools.name: appeal_denied_again_what_next
tools.description: What comes after a health insurance appeal is denied: the next level for the plan type (independent external review, the automatic independent review for Medicare Advantage, a state fair hearing for Medicaid, court), the deadline for it computed from the date of the final denial, and a draft request

tools.name: independent_external_review
tools.description: Independent external review of a health insurance denial: what it is (a reviewer outside the insurer decides, and the plan pays if they side with the person), who can ask (not grandfathered plans), the four-month deadline computed from the final denial, the expedited version, and the regulation text

tools.name: urgent_insurance_appeal
tools.description: Expedited appeals for when the person or their doctor says waiting could seriously harm their health: how fast the plan has to decide (72 hours for employer, Marketplace, Medicare Advantage and Medicaid plans), the filing deadline, the expedited external review that can run at the same time, and the

tools.name: prior_authorization_denied
tools.description: A prior authorization (pre-approval) denied before care: the appeal path for the plan type, the filing deadline, how fast the plan has to decide a pre-service appeal (30 days for employer plans, 15 per level with two levels; 30 days for Medicare Advantage; 72 hours if urgent), and a draft appeal. tools.description: A denial that says the care was not medically necessary: the appeal path and deadline for the plan type, the rule that the appeal considers new evidence (such as a letter from the person's doctor), the right to the claim file, and a draft appeal built for this reason. tools.description: The right to a free copy of the claim file (every document, record and guideline the insurer relied on) for employer, government employer and Marketplace plans, with the regulation text verbatim and a short request letter with blanks to fill. tools.name: draft_insurance_appeal_letter
tools.description: A draft health insurance appeal letter from facts alone, when there is no letter text to paste: addressed for the plan type's appeal level, with a paragraph for the denial reason, the claim-file and new-evidence requests where the rules give them, and blanks for anything not given.
